sites.why: Rule 8: AsyncOpenAI(api_key=config['api_key'] <- env OPENAI_API_KEY), no base_url (SDK reads OPENAI_BASE_URL env, defaults to api.openai.com). Model is config['model'] (env OPENAI_MODEL, default 'gpt-4o') or config['vision_model'] (env VISION_MODEL, default 'gpt-4o'), chosen at runtime; 'gpt-4o' and other repo literals (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4, o1...) are catalog ids. Main chat call (__common_get_chat_response), streaming/non-streaming, legacy functions/function_call and n choices.

Rule 8: same client; follow-up chat call after a plugin function call (__handle_function_call), model=config['model'] from env OPENAI_MODEL (default 'gpt-4o', a catalog id), legacy functions/function_call, optional stream.
Rule 1: client.images.generate (DALL-E, model from env IMAGE_MODEL default 'dall-e-2'); Router has no images endpoint.
Rule 1: client.audio.speech.create (TTS, model from env TTS_MODEL default 'tts-1'); Router has no audio endpoint. Also reached via the auto_tts plugin (helper.generate_speech).
Rule 1: client.audio.transcriptions.create (Whisper, literal 'whisper-1'); Router has no audio endpoint.

Rule 8: same client; vision chat call (__common_get_chat_response_vision) with image_url content parts, model=config['vision_model'] from env VISION_MODEL (default 'gpt-4o', a catalog id), optional stream.
Rule 8: same client; history summarisation call (__summarise), model=config['model'] from env OPENAI_MODEL (default 'gpt-4o', a catalog id).
